messages:
Maria: Quick sync — draft product post is in Figma (link below). Need copy lock + legal pass by EOD Thu. Also want to lock webinar registration tiers (free / trial / customer) so HubSpot can route leads. Can folks review? https://figma.com/file/xyz123

Alex: On it. Dropping a quick pass now. Do we have hero headline options?

Maria: Added two variants in frame 'hero-v1' and 'hero-v2'. V1 is punchier; V2 is explanatory. Link: https://figma.com/file/xyz123?node-id=45

Raj: I can do legal tomorrow morning — flagging that any claim about cost/latency needs source. Which benchmark are we citing?

Maria: Using Optimize bench: ~30% token cost reduction vs baseline model. Attached eval doc in the Figma comments. Please avoid 'guarantee'.

Elaine: For HubSpot routing, propose hidden field `launch_segment` with values `free|trial|customer`. Workflow mapping: free -> 'nurture_launch' list, trial -> 'sales_inbound', customer -> 'account_engage'. Also add tag `launch_interest` and score +10. I'll paste a sample form payload:
```
{"hs_context": {"launch_segment": "trial"}, "lead_source": "launch_blog", "tags": ["launch_interest"]}
```

Tom: Design note — hero copy needs to be 1 line on mobile. Can we trim V2? Tried a 1-line swap in figma.

Liz: Product thumbs up on including the benchmark callout, but please change '3x throughput' to 'up to 3x observed throughput' per legal.

Raj: Agree. Replace absolute language. Also remove 'revolutionary' adjective; it's marketing fluff that triggers extra review.

Maria: Updated copy in Figma w/ legal-friendly phrasing, trimmed hero V2 to one line, and added CTA mapping (Register -> webinar list; Read -> blog). Calendar bot — can you schedule review slot?

marketing-bot: Created event 'Launch copy review' on 2026-03-25 10:00 PDT — invite sent to Maria, Alex, Raj, Elaine, Tom, Liz. :white_check_mark:

Elaine: I'll set up HubSpot workflows tonight and share replay flows. If we can finalize copy by EOD Thu, I can wire the forms and test lead routing by Fri AM.

Alex: Quick A/B for hero — V1 or V2? Vote with emoji on the figma comments. :+1: for V1, :heart: for V2.

Maria: Awesome, thanks team. I'll ping when legal signoff is in comments.
